verdict.rationale: HeyGen documents an API endpoint that returns the user's credit balance and plan tier, intended for in-app credit displays (heygen-docs-9), and a Stripe-backed project wallet for funding API usage (heygen-docs-16). Together these give a basic way to watch remaining credits, but nothing in the evidence shows a cost estimate before a generation is run, or any spend history or usage report afterwards. Missing for 10: pre-generation cost quotes in credits or dollars, per-generation cost breakdowns, spend history or usage reporting, independent corroboration.
